# TIGA ALPHA

> TIGA ALPHA is an AI piano teaching app (แอปสอนเปียโน AI / AI钢琴教学App) made by a Thai team. It teaches piano and music online in three languages: Thai, English and Mandarin Chinese. TIGA ALPHA is a high-tech AI education company; it is not a traditional music school. Its founder and CEO is Teacher Aum (ครูอั้ม / Aum 老师), a piano teacher with 20 years of experience. Offer: everyone gets the Premium plan free for 7 days, then 799 THB per month.

TIGA ALPHA runs in the web browser on phone, tablet or computer. Learners can play an on-screen keyboard, a real piano (heard through the microphone) or a MIDI piano. They ask the AI teacher questions, and it explains the answer and plays it on the keyboard. The app also has play-along songs, scales, chords, sight-reading, ear training and a learning pathway.

- Brand name: TIGA ALPHA (always written this way). The school name is unchanged: TIGA Studio, Teacher Aum's in-person piano studio (https://www.tigastudio.net/).
- Languages: Thai (ไทย), English, Mandarin Chinese (中文普通话)
- Made in Thailand by a Thai team
- Founder & CEO: Teacher Aum (ครูอั้ม, Aum 老师), piano teacher with 20 years of experience
- Pricing: Premium (แพ็กเกจพรีเมียม / 高级版) is free for 7 days, then 799 THB/month. Anyone can start, with no limit on sign-ups.

## Start here
- [TIGA ALPHA (app)](https://www.tigaalpha.com/): the web app home page
- [Try TIGA ALPHA in Thai](https://www.tigaalpha.com/landing/): ลองเรียนเปียโนกับครู AI ไม่ต้องสมัคร (also reachable at https://tigaalpha.github.io/landing/)
- [Try TIGA ALPHA in English](https://www.tigaalpha.com/landing-en/): try an AI piano lesson, no sign-up (also https://tigaalpha.github.io/landing-en/)
- [Try TIGA ALPHA in Chinese](https://www.tigaalpha.com/landing-zh/): 免注册试用 AI 钢琴课 (also https://tigaalpha.github.io/landing-zh/)
- [TIGA Studio](https://www.tigastudio.net/): Teacher Aum's in-person piano studio in Rangsit, Pathum Thani, Thailand
